_comments: FINANCE EXCEPTION CHECK, TYPE 3 (golive #279). Its own file for the same coordination reason as
`.sales-forecast-actions.json`: MetadataSync reads every dot-json here, so separate files do not
The threshold is not a parameter. It is MinDaysSinceClose on the WON_DEAL_ORDER_NOT_CONFIRMED
exception type, which accounting owns, so finance changes it in one place. A missing or inactive
type makes the run skip, which is what makes this safe to ship Active before accounting seeds it.

fields.Name: Detect Won Deals With Unconfirmed Orders
fields.Description: Raise one finance exception (WON_DEAL_ORDER_NOT_CONFIRMED) per won deal whose order is missing or not Confirmed, older than the type's MinDaysSinceClose. Idempotent per deal: a deal already raised, in any status, is not raised again. Skips when the exception type is missing or inactive.
fields.UserPrompt: Check for won deals whose order was never confirmed and raise finance exceptions for them.
